page_title: ROM 1-0 LAZ | AS Roma v Lazio 06/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Daniele De Rossi appears to have said too much and referee Marco Guida comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
90+6' Marco Guida shows a yellow card to Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) for a tough tackle.
90+6' Tammy Abraham (AS Roma) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+3' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) sees a yellow card from Marco Guida after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
85' Lazio work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
81' Edoardo Bove (AS Roma) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Leandro Paredes.
80' Marco Guida shows a yellow card to Leandro Paredes (AS Roma), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
80' A corner kick by Lazio is thwarted by the well prepared Mile Svilar (AS Roma).
80' Substitution. Adam Marusic walks off the pitch and Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) comes on as a substitute.
80' Daniele De Rossi decides to make a substitution. Paulo Dybala will be replaced by Tammy Abraham (AS Roma).
80' That's the end of the game for Angelino, who is replaced by Chris Smalling (AS Roma).
77' The percentage of ball possession is – 52:48.
76' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Marco Guida ignores the protests.
73' Marco Guida shows the yellow card to Pedro (Lazio) for a heavy challenge.
72' Adam Marusic (Lazio) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
71' Here is a change. Stephan El Shaarawy is going off and Daniele De Rossi gives the last tactical orders to Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma).
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Matias Vecino departs the field of play to be replaced by Luis Alberto (Lazio).
69' Felipe Anderson (Lazio) takes a mid-range free kick, but his miskick only goes into the stands. Poor shot! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
68' The foul by Zeki Celik (AS Roma) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Marco Guida.

67' The corner is slung over and Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) out jumps the defence inside the six-yard box, but the header skims off the top of his head and goes miles wide of the right post for a goal kick. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
67' Felipe Anderson (Lazio) will take the corner.
64' Daichi Kamada (Lazio) has a goal ruled out for offside!
63' The corner from Felipe Anderson (Lazio) is intercepted by the defence.
62' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Now Lazio have a corner.
60' AS Roma hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
57' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) has a sight of goal and shoots from distance, but Mile Svilar is equal to it.
55' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
54' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) picks up an accurate pass inside the box and unleashes a shot goalwards that smashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
54' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 13:5.
49' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) attempts to score from a mid-range free kick, but he curls his effort a few inches over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
48' Marco Guida interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Nicolo Casale (Lazio). That's a free kick to AS Roma.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Igor Tudor gives a chance to Taty Castellanos (Lazio) and Ciro Immobile is off.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Alessio Romagnoli comes off for Patric (Lazio).
46' Half-time substitution. Gustav Isaksen is replaced by Pedro (Lazio).
46' Referee Marco Guida blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) was too forceful with his tackle and Marco Guida interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.

42' 1 - 0 Goal! Paulo Dybala sent a fine cross from the corner kick. The perfect pass found Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) and his bullet header from around the penalty spot went straight into the left side of the goal. The score is 1:0.
42' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) takes the corner.

42' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma). The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. AS Roma will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
39' Lazio take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

38' Daichi Kamada almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Mario Gila (Lazio) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players. Lazio have been awarded a corner kick.
37' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) tries to latch onto a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defending players intercepts the effort and the danger passes.
35' What a miss! A floated cross from the flank picks out Zeki Celik (AS Roma) unmarked near the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat, but he skies his header miles over the bar.
34' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
33' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
31' Marco Guida blows his whistle. Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) commits a foul after dangerous play.
29' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) latches onto a cross but somehow sends his close-range header high over the bar.
28' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
27' Matias Vecino (Lazio) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.

23' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) produces a long-range cannon of a shot after a nice pass. The ball heads towards the right post, but is stopped by a great save from Christos Mandas and the score remains the same.
22' Mario Gila (Lazio) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
21' Today's referee Marco Guida rightly decides to book Matias Vecino (Lazio) for his harsh tackle.
20' It looks like Adam Marusic (Lazio) saw red with that tackle. Marco Guida won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
19' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
19' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
18' Matias Vecino (Lazio) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. The linesman makes the right call and Lazio will have a corner.
15' Felipe Anderson (Lazio) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
13' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
11' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) commits a foul and Marco Guida immediately signals a free kick.
10' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
10' Diego Llorente (AS Roma) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. AS Roma can continue in their attacking effort.
9' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) is penalised for holding. Marco Guida signals a set piece. A free kick has been awarded to AS Roma.
7' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post.
6' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) plays a through ball but overhits it.
5' Matias Vecino (Lazio) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
4' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.

2' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) neatly controls a driven pass on the edge of the box, glances up and cracks a beautiful drive goalwards that sails just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
2' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

1' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
AS Roma will kick the game off.
Marco Guida will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
